name: Disk Usage Analyzer
tagline: Shows which folders and files take up space

offers.label: Analyze
offers.description: The folder the person chose, made the folder measured now and its own chain's start.

offers.label: Open place
offers.description: Measures a folder offered on the places page, starting a chain of its own.

offers.label: Go back
offers.description: Goes back one folder, and from the folder the chain started at to the places page.

offers.label: Show places
offers.description: Shows the places, on this device and measured lately.

offers.label: Choose a folder
offers.description: Asks the person which folder to measure, showing the folders of this device.

offers.label: Go
offers.description: Walks the picker to `path` and shows the folders in it.

offers.label: Analyze this folder
offers.description: Measures the folder the picker shows.

offers.label: Cancel
offers.description: Leaves the chooser without measuring anything.

offers.label: Read picker
offers.description: Reads the folders of the one the picker shows.
